wiz.provider.signup: Don't have an account? Sign up →
wiz.provider.vps.tip.title: You only need an account — not a server
wiz.provider.vps.tip.body: Don't create a server on their website. Just sign up, then in the console go to your project (Default) → Security → API Tokens → Generate API Token (select Read & Write). Copy and paste that token here. Daal creates and configures the server for you automatically — the right size, operating system, firewall, everything. Costs around €4–5/month.

recipient.address.title: My Daal address
recipient.address.explain: Share this address with someone who's running a Daal server. They'll use it to send you a relay pack only your phone can open.
recipient.address.footer: This address identifies this phone. Reinstalling makes a new address; ask the publisher for a fresh pack.
recipient.address.passphrase_required: Enter the session passphrase first (min 6 characters).
add.file.sbpx_custody_hint: This pack is sealed for this phone. It will open automatically using your device's key.
add.err.rejected: The relay engine refused this bundle.
recipient.import.sbpx_pin_required: This file is encrypted (.sbpx). Enter your PIN to open it.
recipient.import.not_yours: This relay pack was sent to a different phone.
recipient.import.corrupt: The file is damaged or was not made by Daal.
recipient.import.identity_missing: Set up your Daal address first, then ask the publisher to send the pack again.
recipient.import.legacy_warning: This pack was not encrypted. Anyone who could read the file in transit could see the credentials inside. Ask the publisher for a .sbpx next time.
wiz.intro.3step: Stand up a private relay your family and friends can use. Three screens, about ten minutes.
wiz.step.cloud.title: Connect your cloud account
wiz.step.cloud.blurb: Your relay runs on a rented cloud server. Sign up with a provider if you haven't, then paste the access key they give you. Daal keeps it in this device's protected storage — there is no PIN to remember.
wiz.step.plan.title: Name it and pick a size
wiz.step.plan.blurb: Give this relay a name so you can tell it apart later, then choose how big a server to rent. Prices come live from your cloud account.
wiz.step.build.title: Building your relay
wiz.step.build.blurb: Daal is creating the server, hardening it, and signing the file your recipients will import. This takes a few minutes.
wiz.provider.token.stored: Your access key is already saved on this device. Leave this blank to keep it.
wiz.plan.name.label: Name this relay
wiz.plan.name.help: Only you see this. It labels the relay here and names the file you share.
wiz.plan.existing.title: Your existing servers
wiz.plan.existing.note: Choosing an existing server wipes it and reinstalls it with Daal's configuration. Same address, no extra charges.
wiz.plan.new.title: Or create a new server
wiz.plan.empty: No server sizes came back from your cloud account. Check the access key on the previous screen.
wiz.plan.footnote.existing: Using your existing server. No new charges.
wiz.plan.footnote.new: Protocols are chosen automatically for the best censorship resistance. Every size includes 20 TB of bandwidth.
wiz.build.stage.sign: Building and signing the relay pack
wiz.build.hint: This takes a few minutes. Keep the app open — you can watch the log below.
wiz.build.fail.profile: Couldn't save your server choices. Go back and pick a size again.
wiz.build.fail.keys: Couldn't create the signing key on this device.
wiz.build.fail.provision: Couldn't finish setting up the server.
wiz.build.fail.sign: The server is up, but building the relay pack failed. Nothing was lost — your server is safe.
wiz.build.fail.share: Your relay is running, but the shareable connection file wasn't created. You can build it later from the relay page.
wiz.build.done.body: Your relay is live and the connection file is ready to share.
wiz.helperip.title: Your network address changed
wiz.helperip.body: Daal briefly opens your server's firewall for your own address. Yours has changed — confirm it and try again.
wiz.helperip.label: Your public IP address
wiz.helperip.invalid: That doesn't look like an IP address.
wiz.cancel.confirm:
Remove this relay from Daal?

This only removes it from the app. If a cloud server is already running it will keep running and you will still be charged — delete it from your cloud provider's dashboard to stop billing.

relaypack.p1: A RelayPack is a small set of internet routes your diaspora family member set up for you on a server outside Iran. Your Daal app picks the route that works best on your network right now. If one route stops working, Daal switches to another automatically.
relaypack.p2: They rented a small server (about €5/month) and ran a one-time wizard that sets the server up safely. The server is yours; nothing leaves their machine; nobody else uses your routes.
relaypack.h3: What does your Daal app do?
relaypack.p3: When your network changes — new Wi-Fi, mobile data, café — Daal runs five small probes to see what works on this network. It picks the best route from your RelayPack and explains its choice in one sentence. If a route fails, it cools down and tries another. No information leaves your phone.
wiz.build.resume.title: Ready to create your server
wiz.build.resume.body: Picking up where you left off. The next step rents a server on your cloud account and starts billing. If you meant to reuse a server you already own, review the plan first — that choice wasn't saved.
